changelog:
vox-director 0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Automates end-to-end creation of Vox-style paper-collage explainer or ad videos from a single topic.
- Integrates Atlas Cloud API and local ffmpeg to generate script, collage keyframes, animation, narration, music, and captions.
- Supports interactive workflow for beat mapping, style/theme selection, keyframe generation, motion animation, voice/music synthesis, and final assembly.
- Designed for modern editorial collage looks, customizable visual and motion styles, and multilanguage narration.
- Includes quality-control gates and references for beat structure and style prompt construction.
